RiseBase.note: Legacy analytic brightening fallback; the normal profile uses the WS4 nominal reconstructed table.

FallBase.note: Legacy analytic darkening fallback; the normal profile uses the WS4 nominal reconstructed table.

NearTransitionDrag.note: Legacy analytic fallback near-level drag prior.

MidGrayDrag.note: Legacy analytic fallback middle-gray drag prior.

GtgTableBackend.note: Normal profile selects the WS4 nominal literature-constrained table; missing corners still use the analytic fallback.

TemporalResponse.note: Enables the current WS4 table-backed GtG reconstruction.

HcsMeasuredColor.note: Selects the HCS measurement-derived color path.

HcsChromaticAdaptation.note: Retains the measured native white instead of adapting it to D65.

HcsImproveContrast.note: Applies the HCS black-subtracted policy; this is not raw emitted black.

DriveRetention.note: Enables the one-state residual-DC reconstruction; SpatialRetention independently selects global-only or code/polarity-dependent excitation.

SpatialRetention.note: Selects the WS5 normalized RGB555-code/polarity excitation proxy. It is reconstructed, not measured image sticking.

SpatialCodeWeight.note: Nominal sensitivity midpoint for code-dependent resultant feed-through/VCOM imbalance; dimensionless and not a voltage.

PolarityDriveWeight.note: Nominal sensitivity midpoint for polarity-dependent resultant imbalance; topology and phase remain WS3 hypotheses.

DriveDcOffset.note: Normalized global residual-DC bridge prior; no pristine AGS-101 measurement exists.

IonAdsorptionRate.note: Midpoint of a contemporary TFT laboratory-cell range, not an AGS-101 measurement.

IonDesorptionRate.note: Midpoint of a contemporary TFT laboratory-cell range, not an AGS-101 measurement.

DriveCodeCoupling.note: Normalized electrical-to-code bridge prior. Zero is the balanced isolation control, not the normal default.

BakedScanout.note: Enables the three-event theoretical scan reconstruction.

LatchOffsetLines.note: Family- and cross-model-constrained line-boundary reconstruction default; not a captured AGT-CPU-01 edge. Line-center remains a sensitivity control.

OpticalDelaySeconds.note: No additional pure-delay prior; not a measured zero-delay result.

ParityPhase.note: Legacy even-frame-positive candidate. The AGS-101 polarity phase is not established.

InversionTopology.note: Row-alternating plus frame reversal is the best available Sharp-family reconstruction default. Frame-global, column, and dot remain sensitivity controls; exact AGT REVC phase was not captured.

ApertureGain.note: Unit-energy project convention for the analytic aperture candidate.

ApertureEnabled.note: Enables the generic analytic aperture candidate.

ApertureHorizontalRadius.note: lcd-grid-v2-derived nominal radius; narrow and wide WS6 variants are sensitivity candidates, not AGS measurements.

ApertureVerticalRadius.note: lcd-grid-v2-derived nominal radius; the shader normalizes every geometry candidate to unit mean linear-light energy.

BlackLevel.note: Candidate black floor used only by the neutral adapter; the measured HCS path ignores it.

BGR.note: Prior-art-informed subpixel-order candidate pending calibrated AGS-101 aperture imaging.

BacklightScaleEnabled.note: Disabled by default so unresolved low/high brightness uncertainty cannot alter the measured HCS static-color stage.

BacklightRelativeGain.note: Dimensionless sensitivity control only. The generated 0.5/0.75/1.0 sweep is not a measured ratio or physical bound.

ExposureMode.note: One selects exact native-frame emitted-light averaging. Zero is the named frame-boundary endpoint diagnostic; neither changes Pass 0 feedback state.

DebugView.note: Normal rendering selector; diagnostic values 1 through 14 are read-only. Value 13 losslessly encodes WS8 exposure RGB, FrameCount, and current RGB555; value 14 emits quarter-linear aperture energy for integer/fractional GPU averaging.

generated/gtg-synthetic-v1.png.note: Bound only by gtg-synthetic-table-v1; never used by the normal profile.

generated/ws4-gtg-nominal-v1.png.note: Normal runtime reference; every cell is reconstructed rather than measured.

presets/retention-stress-60x-v1.slangp.note: Accelerated laboratory diagnostic, never a normal-play parameter set.

targetCompensation.note: KONKR/frontend behavior is recorded under the target profile and is not AGS-101 panel evidence.
